goal: Defeat Giovanni in the Rocket Hideout for the Silph Scope

subgoals.goal_text: Since the party is out of PP and EEVEE is fainted, return to the Celadon City Pokemon Center to heal and restore PP before fighting Giovanni.
Travel back to the Rocket Hideout and use the elevator to reach the bottom floor (B4F).
Locate and defeat Giovanni in battle.
Interact with Giovanni to receive the Silph Scope.
